name: banh-mi-cho-pos
description: Banh Mi Cho operational POS monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bmc/contracts && npm run build -w @bmc/store-hub && npm run build -w @bmc/web-pos && npm run build -w @bmc/web-owner && npm run build -w @bmc/cloud-api
scripts.check: npm run build -w @bmc/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/store-hub && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/web-pos && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/web-owner && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/mobile-staff && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/cloud-api
scripts.test:integration: node --test tests/store.test.mjs tests/concurrency.test.mjs tests/sync-backfill.test.mjs tests/order-ack.test.mjs tests/printer.test.mjs tests/restore.test.mjs tests/operational-status.test.mjs tests/pos-pending-cash.test.mjs tests/remote-gateway.test.mjs tests/idempotency-binding.test.mjs tests/cashier-queue.test.mjs tests/receipt-content.test.mjs tests/owner-analytics-hub.test.mjs
